117634.name: Chabad Center and Lubavitch of Maryland
117634.note: Chabad.org obituary of Rochel Kaplan on CrownHeights.info, 4 Feb 2024: 'She and her husband were married in 1972. A few years later, in 1974, with the blessings of the Rebbe ... the young couple moved to Baltimore and established a home for Chabad-Lubavitch'. Rabbi Shmuel Kaplan is the head shliach of Maryland.

117635.name: Lubavitch Center of Howard County
117635.note: CrownHeights.info, 12 Feb 2017: 'Yisroel Susskind was living in Columbia County when the Barons moved to town in 1986'; 'The Barons have been in Columbia for three decades, since a week after their wedding'.

117636.name: Chabad of Upper Montgomery County
117636.note: Washington Jewish Week, 28 July 2025: 'In the summer of 1990, Raichik and his wife, Chana Raichik, launched Chabad of Upper Montgomery County in their Montgomery Village home.'

118183.name: Bais Menachem Chabad Jewish Student Center
118183.note: Mitzpeh (UMD), 29 Sept 2025: 'Since arriving in College Park in 1995, the Backmans have only had one other Chabad family join them on campus.' Rabbi Eli and Nechama Backman, University of Maryland.

118606.name: Chabad of Johns Hopkins & Central Baltimore
118606.note: Lubavitch.com, 2 Oct 2003: 'New Chabad representatives Rabbi Velvel and Chanie Gopin arrived to central Baltimore earlier this month, to service Jewish students and faculty members at Johns Hopkins University'. Lubavitch.com, 1 Dec 2016: Rabbi Zev and Chani Gopin, at Johns Hopkins 'since 2003'.

262384.name: Chabad of Silver Spring
262384.note: CrownHeights.info, 11 Dec 2007: 'The Wolvovskys started the chapter in Silver Spring three years ago'. Medium: counted back; its chabad.org listing went up 20 Feb 2005.

1218941.name: Harford Chabad
1218941.note: CrownHeights.info, 28 Oct 2026: 'In September 2010, shortly before Rosh Hashanah, the Schustermans moved to Bel Air.' Its chabad.org listing went up 27 May 2010.

2818884.name: JCrafts
2818884.note: CrownHeights.info, 20 Aug 2015: 'Rabbi Levi Raskin, director of JCrafts, a mobile project of Chabad-Lubavitch of Maryland launched in 2012'. This listing only went up in 2015.
